law: workflows-and-surfaces section 3 pivot table + comparison-result #/$defs/PivotPresence, pivotsAvailable and DetectorDisposition.method

pivots.B: the baseline artifact entries (a retained artifact, not an execution)
pivots.E0: the PRIOR detector closure executed over current source (an execution that needs the closure retained, trusted and runnable; a committed pivot Run)
pivots.E1: the current detector re-evaluated under the baseline POLICY (no execution)
pivots.E2: the current detector and policy re-evaluated under the baseline SCOPE
pivots.E3: the current detector, policy and scope re-evaluated under the baseline WAIVERS

pivotOnlyScenario.standing: the E0 pivot Run and the prior closure are synthetic helper-only

scopeOnlyScenario.e2Derivation: E2 = current detector, current policy, BASELINE scope: the retained current findings whose subject the embedded baseline ScopeDocumentV1 selects; the scope document selects subjects, it changes no fact or Coverage

presenceNullMeans: null means the pivot was not bound (not-needed or unavailable); false means it was bound and the fingerprint was absent
